function.name: get_rag_context
function.description: Call this ONLY if more context is required to answer the user query.

user_query.description: The user query verbatim, retaining all named entities.

categories.description: The categories of information needed to answer the user query.

strategy.description: Strategy to answer the user query. Choose 'explore_neighborhood' to extract broad context or information related to one entity. Choose 'find_path_between' to find ANY form of interaction, connection or relationship between two or more entities.
